tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Apacer AH25C 32GB USB 3.2 Gen 1 Flash Drive is a compact and reliable portable storage device designed for fast and efficient data transfers. Featuring the modern USB 3.2 Gen 1 interface, this USB flash drive delivers high-speed performance, making it perfect for transferring photos, videos, documents, and other important files.


With a 32GB capacity, it offers enough space for everyday storage needs and is lightweight enough to take with you wherever you go. The flash drive is also backward compatible with USB 2.0, ensuring seamless use with a wide range of laptops, desktops, smart TVs, and other USB-enabled devices.


Whether you’re a student, professional, or casual user, the Apacer AH25C provides reliable performance at an affordable price.


Buy the genuine Apacer 32GB USB 3.2 flash drive at the best price in Bangladesh from D CORE.


Key Features


  • Capacity: 32GB
  • Interface: USB 3.2 Gen 1
  • Backward Compatible: USB 2.0
  • Plug & Play: No drivers required
  • Compact & Portable: Easy to carry anywhere
  • Wide Compatibility: Works with laptops, desktops, smart devices
  • Durable Storage: Designed for everyday usage
